titulo: Two words on the thread: got it
caption:
Two words on the thread: got it

Two words on the thread, and the three dots on the other end stopped waiting.

A "got it" takes four seconds, and it saves the other person an hour of wondering.

For whoever answers got it so the other person can stop wondering.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a chat bubble with three pulsing dots, like someone waiting. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and a bubble that says got it. pops up, and the dots stop. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me, they can see I read it, to: got it. now they can stop guessing.
